source_fixture_boundary.claim_boundary: The matrix makes the existing Stage-A contract implementable. It adds no candidate behavior and supplies no empirical, formal-project or literature claim.

audit_dimensions.H_meaning: exact number of Stage-A trace-family rows; this audit symbol is not the current local state H used in SEMANTIC_ACCEPT(E,H)
audit_dimensions.complexity_contract: For each of H=23 frozen rows, inspect its K=16 attribution cells once and execute its finite declared fixture once. The fixtures and all branch counts are fixed in this packet, so the matrix scan is exactly 368 cells and the complete deterministic audit is O(H*K); no data-dependent row, column, branch or retry is admitted.

frozen_trace_language.trace_isolation: Every T01-T23 row runs in a new empty fixture namespace. Every explicitly named branch inside T01, T15 and T21-T23 is an isolated execution and never shares a live ledger with another branch.
frozen_trace_language.attribution_bitmap_rule: Sixteen characters ordered M01 through M16; 1 means the row or an explicitly named isolated row branch is registered as a direct attribution test for that source case. A fixture prerequisite or contrast control alone remains 0.
frozen_trace_language.event_order_rule: Each event_order array is the exact atomic-boundary processing order after its observation_order snapshot. Within one boundary, the source exclusive-cause priority is applied before residual or handoff effects.
frozen_trace_language.count_rule: All call and commit counts are per isolated row or per explicitly named isolated variant. Unlisted calls and commits equal zero.
frozen_trace_language.terminal_state_rule: end_state is the exact state after the last declared boundary. RUNNING and SEMANTIC_WAITING are valid nonabsorbing trace endpoints; HANDED_OFF and TERMINAL_* states are absorbing.

matrix_gate.pass_rule: Execute T01-T23 once in source order in isolated namespaces and evaluate all K=16 attribution bits for every row. All hard-gate, residual, ledger, safe-wait, handoff, cause-priority, count, absorbing-state and invariance assertions must match exactly. Any mismatch is INVALID_STAGE_A_CONFORMANCE and blocks Stage B.
